title: A first-in Human Research Study on How NNC0773-2662 Works in People Living With Overweight or Obesity
official: A Randomized, Double-Blinded, Placebo-Controlled Study, Investigating the Safety, Tolerability, and Pharmacokinetics of Single and Multiple Ascending Doses of NNC0773-2662 in Participants With Overweight or Obesity
summary: The purpose of this clinical study is to find out if NNC0773-2662 is safe for treating people who are living with overweight or obesity.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female (sex assigned at birth, inclusive of all gender identities)
* Age 18-55 (both inclusive) at the time of signing the informed consent
* Considered eligible based on the medical history, physical examination, and the results of vital signs, electrocardiogram and clinical laboratory tests performed during the screening visit, as judged by the investigator

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known or suspected hypersensitivity to study intervention(s) or related products.
* Presence or history of any clinically relevant respiratory, metabolic, renal, hepatic, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, or endocrinological conditions
* Any disorder, unwillingness or inability which in the investigator's opinion, might jeopardise the participant's safety or compliance with the protocol.
* Glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) more than or equal to (≥) 6.5 percent (%) \[48 nanomoles per mole (mmol/mol)\] at screening.
* Female who is pregnant, breast-feeding or intends to become pregnant or is of childbearing potential and not using adequate contraceptive method.
